about: Custom types P3: (a) wolf (harness_type_a, map all) installed but locked: no raid page arrows, the vanilla top bar and raid column, and the travel selector offers only the game's four. (b) otter comes from a village mod (harness_type_village, no "map"): unlocked on the village, it is not offered for a trip to the mod map harness_map, while wolf (map all) is. A mod with no "map" owns no map, so an owner-only rule would offer otter; gnx_travel_type_ok reads the mod's map declaration.
